text: An expert says one sentence too many.
And suddenly, your research is inside information.
Usually, nobody catches it until someone reads the transcript, days later.
It listens along, and reads every turn against your firm's own policy.
The banker never sees a transcript. No suggestions. No noise. Only this.
And if a warning doesn't land in time, nothing is lost. When the call ends, Blink reads the whole transcript again, hides every flagged passage, and sends it to compliance.
Compliance sees the exact quotes, the rule that fired, and why.
The rules are your rules. Written in plain English, compiled, tested against every combination of evidence, and approved by hash.
Only then is a summary drafted, from cleared statements alone, with every sentence cited.
The banker reads only what was released. Restricted passages are blank. The hidden words never reach their browser.
Every action lands in a tamper-evident audit log. Every call is measured. Even the misses.
Talk freely. Compliance decides the rest.
